name: Quadrupolar Flux Confinement Chamber
purpose: Four alternating pole shoes establish a transverse field gradient for two-axis pickup calibration.
variables: G [T/m], offsets x and y [m]

name: Magnetohydrodynamic Recirculation Manifold
purpose: Electrically conductive aqueous bypass crosses the calibration field. An external pump supplies net hydraulic power.
equation: dp_mhd = χ σ B² L u
variables: Conductivity σ [S/m], field B [T], wetted length L [m], velocity u [m/s], closure χ [1]

name: Topological Soliton Retention Lattice
purpose: Coupled bistable flexure cells support a discrete domain wall between opposite displacement equilibria.
equation: m q̈i + c q̇i = k(qi−1−2qi+qi+1) + a qi − b qi³
variables: Displacement q [m], m [kg], c [N·s/m], k and a [N/m], b [N/m³]

name: Ferrohydrodynamic Instability Governor
purpose: Optical readout of a sealed magnetizable-fluid cell sets a conservative field-margin request for the manifold.
equation: ρ ω² = ρ g k + γ k³ − α B² k²
variables: Surface tension γ [N/m], wavenumber k [m⁻¹], density ρ [kg/m³], fitted magnetic coefficient α [N/(m²·T²)], field B [T]
failure: Fluid contamination, poor calibration or optical saturation

name: Nonreciprocal Phononic Detraction Array
purpose: Two powered reciprocal transducers acquire and re-emit vibration with unequal feedback cross gains.
variables: Directional gains gij [1], baseline frequency response H0 [m/N]

name: Chronometric Hysteresis Governor
purpose: Asymmetric on/off thresholds and a dwell interval prevent rapid fan-state switching.
variables: Temperatures T [°C], minimum dwell Δt [s]

name: Biaxial Nutation Arrestor
purpose: Orthogonal gimbal axes and viscoelastic torque feedback damp small shaft-support tilts.
equation: I θ̈ + (C + G) θ̇ + K θ = τ
variables: Tilt θ [rad], inertia I [kg·m²], damping C and gyroscopic skew G [N·m·s/rad], K [N·m/rad]

name: Helicoidal Flux Inverter
purpose: A helical excitation winding reverses the axial test field when drive current is reversed.
variables: Permeability μ0 [H/m], turns N [1], current I [A], length L and mean radius R [m]
interface: signed test field → ME-040 pickup verification
failure: Open winding or excessive copper loss

name: Quasiperiodic Precession Engine
purpose: Two incommensurate reference frequencies excite a small bounded gimbal-angle command.
equation: θr = A sin(2π f t) + B sin(2π √2 f t)
variables: Amplitude A and B [rad], base frequency f [Hz]

name: Anisotropic Impedance Lattice
purpose: Oriented flexures create two distinct dynamic stiffnesses in the transverse load plane.
equation: Zj = Kj − M ω² + i Cj ω
variables: Dynamic stiffness Z [N/m], mass M [kg], stiffness K [N/m], damping C [N·s/m]

name: Hyperboloidal Phase Conjugator
purpose: Conjugates a measured complex mode and schedules the inverse-phase drive in a buffered, timed reconstruction.
variables: Phasors X and Y [normalized], path transfer H [1]

name: Stochastic Resonance Exciter
purpose: A seeded stochastic dither exercises the bistable detection model under a weak periodic input.
equation: dx = (a x − b x³ + A sin ωt)dt + √(2D)dW
variables: Normalized state x, coefficients a, b, A [s⁻¹], noise D [s⁻¹]

name: Toroidal Vorticity Separator
purpose: An annular passage gives a repeatable tangential hydraulic path and sample ports.
variables: Circulation Γ [m²/s], radius r [m], speed v [m/s], loss K [1]
interface: circulation and loss → ME-020 pressure balance

name: Metastable Bifurcation Governor
purpose: Tracks stable branches of a saddle-node normal form and raises a boundary alert.
variables: Normalized time and state; μ [1]
failure: Branch jump or incorrect sign selection

name: Pseudoadiabatic Entropy Compensator
purpose: Estimates irreversible heat-transfer entropy production and adjusts the heat-load schedule.
variables: Entropy rate [W/K], heat transfer Q̇ [W], absolute T [K]
failure: Wrong temperature scale or sensor offset

name: Gyroscopic Holonomy Resolver
purpose: Integrates a small prescribed attitude loop and compares its geometric orientation phase with encoder drift.
variables: Loop half-angle β and geometric phase γ [rad]

name: Non-Abelian Phase Manifold
purpose: Compares noncommuting ordered attitude rotation updates using unit quaternions.
variables: Unit quaternions q; angular commutator [rad]

name: Pseudocausal Inversion Chamber
purpose: Uses a regularized causal inverse of the two-tap measurement path and reports the remaining residual.
variables: Normalized samples x, y, filter β and λ [1]

name: Toroidal Antiprecession Coupler
purpose: Viscoelastic annular supports couple gimbal tilt to passive restoring torque.
variables: Tilt ψ [rad], torque τ [N·m], kψ [N·m/rad], cψ [N·m·s/rad]

name: Polychronous Eigenmode Discriminator
purpose: A paired DFT correlator separates shaft-order and asynchronous modes before active control.
variables: Modal amplitude Ak in sample units, angular frequencies ωk [rad/s]

name: Recursive Bifurcation Stabilizer
purpose: A bounded feedback gain schedules normal-form decay as the stability margin changes.
variables: x [1], rates μ and k [s⁻¹], saturation β [s⁻¹]
